name: Webdot Store Search Analytics for WooCommerce
author: yubolshova

sections.description:
Webdot Store Search Analytics for WooCommerce helps store owners understand what customers search for.

Features:
* Track customer search queries.
* Identify searches with no results.
* View search activity in the WordPress admin dashboard.
* Review estimated lost revenue.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webdot-store-search-analytics-woocommerce/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Webdot Search Analytics in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.changelog:
0.2.0

  • Added a modern dashboard with an Estimated Lost Revenue metric.
  • Added a premium upgrade banner.
  • Improved tracking of different “No products found” text variations.
  • Improved admin CSS styling.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
